  - `deny_payment_request`: POST `/payment_requests/{payment_request_id}/deny`, params: payment_request_id (required), access_token (required).
  - `create_transaction`: POST `/transactions`, params: receiver_email (required), amount (required, > 0), access_token (required), description (optional), payment_card_id (optional), private (optional).
